verdict.rationale: Granola documents private-by-default notes: notes are never shared with participants unless you share the link or add the note to a team-space folder. The sidebar separates a private "My notes" space from a workspace team space, and sharing works through copy-link URLs and team-space folders. Missing for 10: granular link/folder/workspace permission levels (e.g., view/edit, link access scoping), admin visibility or audit of what has been shared, and independent corroboration.
